  • Liderar os rituais adotados pela empresa para o desenvolvimento ágil.
  • Identificar e remover impedimentos que possam impactar os objetivos do time (curto prazo - sprint ou médio prazo - objetivos do quarter).
  • Participar do processo de discovery de funcionalidades envolvendo as pessoas necessárias.
  • Desenvolver planos de lançamento do produto e gerenciar expectativas para a entrega de novas funcionalidades.
  • Receber, refinar e avaliar a viabilidade de novas funcionalidades vindas de clientes internos e externos.

  • Conhecimento intermediário em frameworks de desenvolvimento ágil.

  • Familiaridade com desenvolvimento de sistemas e tecnologias envolvidas no produto.

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

Aliamos o seu desenvolvimento e objetivos de carreira às transformações que trazemos para milhares de brasileiros em nosso dia a dia.

  • Trabalhamos com gente incrível

A revolução que estamos causando no mundo está sendo feita por pessoas e profissionais excelentes. Gente que está sempre aberta a feedbacks e que segue em busca da melhoria contínua. Trabalhar com pessoas assim, nos incentiva a evoluir também e nos puxa na direção de quem desejamos nos tornar.

  • Crescemos juntos

Entendemos que é possível aprender algo novo diariamente e que a prática de aceitar desafios que parecem impossíveis, pode nos levar ao crescimento que queremos vivenciar para a idwall e para a sua carreira também.

Nossos benefícios

  • Caju - cartão com bandeira VISA com saldo de VR + benefícios flexíveis;
  • Auxílio Home Office mensal;

  • Psicólogo, nutricionista ou coaching pelo app ZenKlub (4 sessões por mês);
  • Wellhub;
  • Parcerias educacionais para você se desenvolver como quiser.

Conheça, Também, Nossos Programas De Reconhecimento

  • Wonderwall: acumule idpoints ao praticar ações que reforçam a nossa cultura e troque por prêmios na loja exclusiva da idwall.
  • idmiráveis: todo ano reconhecemos as pessoas que melhor representaram nossos valores.
  • Idfamily: programa de apoio para futuros papais e mamães.

  • Programa de Sociedade: idwallers têm a oportunidade de se tornarem sócios. Além de representarem a nossa cultura, essas pessoas se destacam apresentando constantemente resultados excepcionais e desenvolvimento acelerado em sua jornada.

Onde ficamos?

O modelo de trabalho desse time é full remoto, mas quem quiser pode ir para o escritório que fica na região da Paulista, bem pertinho das estações Paulista e Consolação, em São Paulo - SP.

title: Senior Graphic Designer (Contract)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Graphic Designer with a strong background in digital art and illustration. You will be responsible for creating high-quality in-app promotional materials, social media content, and marketing creatives using our product’s avatars and digital assets. The ideal candidate has senior-level experience in digital asset creation, strong compositing skills, and a versatile portfolio that demonstrates range, consistency, and professional quality across styles.

This role requires both creativity and adaptability — you should bring an AI-forward mindset, be eager to explore and leverage AI tools, and maintain polished, professional outputs without relying on “obvious AI” work. We’re looking for someone collaborative, low ego, and excited to iterate based on feedback to align with brand vision.

Responsibilities:

  • Create compelling digital visuals by styling and posing in-game assets.

  • Design graphics for product promotions, in-app releases, in-app posts, websites, social media, email campaigns, and internal projects.

  • Leverage AI tools and models to ideate, enhance, and polish creative content while maintaining professional quality.

  • Develop and maintain high standards for static graphics and visual storytelling.

  • Create reusable templates for in-app promotions and campaigns.

  • Innovate new approaches to presenting promotions and seasonal content.

  • Collaborate closely with art, product, and live operations teams to deliver creative solutions.

  • Manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment to consistently meet deadlines.

  • Proactively generate and suggest creative ideas to elevate the look and feel of the brand.

  • Stay current with digital design trends and incorporate them thoughtfully into your work.

  • Take full ownership for delivering quality work that meets both deadlines and brand objectives.

Requirements

  • Senior-level experience as a graphic designer or digital artist.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing versatility, compositing skills, and consistent quality across a range of digital design work. (Avoid portfolios limited to one style or heavy in print/traditional design.)

  • Expertise in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.

  • Proven ability in character styling, lighting, effects, backgrounds, and mood/expressions.

  • Strong foundation in drawing, anatomy, perspective, and color theory.

  • Demonstrated skill in adapting to client/brand vision and iterating based on feedback.

  • Collaborative, low-ego approach with excellent communication and teamwork skills.

  • Self-driven with strong organizational and time management abilities.

Bonuses

  • Passion for fashion design.

  • Knowledge of Adobe After Effects and experience creating 2D animated promotional videos.

  • Experience with video editing.

  • Background in character art.

The position will start with an initial 1-month contract period, with the possibility of renewal and extension based on performance and business needs.

title: Recruiter Senior
description:
Overview

Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas

Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.
  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.
  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável

O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.

Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

We’re looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager to help sell our premium AI product and protect ad monetized publishers and ad tech vendors from Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. Our company, MonetizeMore, has been driven by a team of 100+ talented professionals across the globe for 15 years, and we're built on the core pillars of Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen.

Job Overview
We need someone who excels in programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations to ensure the success of our advertising campaigns. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization: Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms.

Job description

A Fundação José Silveira, instituição comprometida com a promoção da saúde e bem-estar na comunidade, busca um analista para integrar a equipe de Planejamento, Custos e Processos . Oferecemos uma oportunidade única para desenvolvimento de habilidades analíticas, contribuição para o crescimento da organização e vivência em uma cultura de trabalho colaborativa e inovadora.

Com uma longa trajetória na prestação de serviços de saúde de qualidade, a Fundação é reconhecida por seu compromisso com a excelência, inovação e responsabilidade social . Nossa cultura organizacional é centrada no comprometimento da equipe, valorizando a diversidade, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e incentivando o desenvolvimento profissional contínuo. A transparência, ética e respeito mútuo são os pilares que promovem um ambiente de trabalho saudável e inspirador.

A equipe de Planejamento, Custos e Processos é formada por profissionais dedicados e experientes, focados na otimização de recursos e na garantia da sustentabilidade financeira da organização . Main responsibilities

  • Mapear, analisar e redesenhar processos de média complexidade, visando eficiência e padronização.
  • Aplicar metodologias de melhoria contínua, como PDCA, 5W2H, SIPOC, entre outras.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização e propor soluções com base em dados e indicadores.
  • Elaborar e revisar fluxogramas, procedimentos e instruções de trabalho, assegurando aderência às normas e boas práticas.

  • Colaborar em projetos multidisciplinares, garantindo a integração dos processos entre áreas.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico a analistas juniores, orientando boas práticas e metodologias.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação com ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de produção, Tecnologia da informação e afins.
  • Desejável curso de especialização em BPM (Gerenciamento de processos de negócios) e técnicas de BPMN (fluxogramação), Lean Six Sigma.
  • Experiência anterior mínima de 02 ano como analista de processos.
  • Competências comportamentais: Adaptabilidade, Comunicação assertiva, Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, Trabalho em equipe, Visão sistêmica, Curiosidade e aprendizagem contínua.

description:
Account Executive, Public Sector (LATAM)

The sales team responsible for our Government sector in LATAM is driven by our mission to make the world a safer place by tracking and investigating activities that involve cryptocurrency like human trafficking, terrorist financing, and money-laundering. We’re experts on the “why” and the “how” with deep relationships and knowledge of navigating government sales processes.

As an Account Executive, you'll establish trust and build strong relationships with Public Sector stakeholders, tailoring your sales approach to meet their needs, and evangelizing Chainalysis solutions in a compelling yet approachable way. You'll measure your success by attainment of assigned quota, accuracy of forecasting, and the growth of accounts in the region. The ideal candidate is an expert at navigating complex sales cycles, building a calculated account plan, and still enjoys the thrill of closing a deal.

In this role, you'll:

  • Achieve your revenue targets and increase our foothold in the government and public sector markets within LATAM through strategic prospecting and expanding existing accounts

  • Build and strengthen relationships with prospective and existing customers, driving new business, expansions, upsells, renewals, and cross-sales

  • Work closely with our Pre-Sales, Customer Success, Investigations, and Marketing teams to lead conversations within your territory

  • Create a diverse pipeline of opportunities, leveraging data from sales figures, marketing campaigns, and promotional activities to drive consistent and accurate forecasting

  • Develop a deep understanding of Chainalysis’ solutions, customer stakeholders, use cases, and key decision-making criteria within your market

  • Provide feedback and insight to help develop compelling product positioning and messaging specific to market trends, competitive drivers, region-specific sales channels, and more

  • Establish relationships across departments at Chainalysis, allowing you to provide expert advice to prospects related to technical concepts, product roadmaps, solutions implementations, and training

  • Demonstrate exceptional expertise in sales forecasting, ensuring precise and reliable predictions to drive informed decision-making and maximize business growth.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • A track record of over-achievement in a public sector sales role, selling to law enforcement and intelligence agencies in LATAM

  • A solid understanding of procurement processes involved in government sales, as well as experience selling with and through channel partners

  • An articulate, enthusiastic, and effective communication style with the ability to convey complex concepts in an approachable and concise way

  • Extensive experience discovering, managing and closing complex software sales in Brazil

  • Experience creating territory and account plans using value selling methodologies

  • An entrepreneurial and relentless hunting attitude with a willingness to prospect

  • The ability to negotiate terms and conditions and other concessions in complex, multi-year sales agreements

  • An insatiable curiosity and willingness to learn about blockchain technology and cryptocurrency

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here . We can’t wait to meet you.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Technical Product Manager III role at Outliant .

Outliant is a fully-remote, US-based, digital product development and startup consulting company with a team of diverse creators who help conceive seamless digital products. Our teams emphasize growth, creativity, and the freedom to think outside the box.

About This Role

We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager with a strong analytical mindset and a proven ability to lead platform-focused initiatives. You’ll join one of our most strategic accounts: a fast-scaling wellness company with a national footprint in the US.

This is not a feature factory role. You’ll be driving cross-functional outcomes , owning platform reliability and scalability , and partnering closely with engineering, SEO, and CRO teams to deliver meaningful impact.

You’ll operate within a newly structured product org where “stability & enablement” is a core business unit — and platform work is treated as first-class priority. This role reports directly to internal product leadership and collaborates with senior stakeholders across engineering, data, SEO, and design.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the platform roadmap: manage initiatives related to site architecture, CMS performance, scalability, QA and SEO foundations — ensuring readiness for 5x growth in clinics and locations.
  • Be technical and decisive: work closely with engineers to debug, unblock, and scope technical solutions. You’ll often be the bridge between messy reality and scalable execution.
  • Drive clarity and impact: translate business outcomes into clear product specs, track results, and relentlessly prioritize high-leverage opportunities.
  • Lead discovery & validation: partner with PMs and stakeholders to validate and prioritize internal and client-facing requests using a structured intake and scoring system.
  • Support SEO enablement: while you won’t own SEO strategy, you’ll ensure the technical platform supports the SEO team’s roadmap — including performance, schema, and scalable content rollout.
  • Own documentation & communication: write clear PRDs, surface tradeoffs, and ensure shared understanding across engineering, QA, and stakeholders.
  • Manage cross-team dependencies: coordinate work between engineering, QA, data, and operations — ensuring blockers are addressed and initiatives stay aligned to roadmap outcomes.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3+ years as a Product Manager, ideally with a technical or platform focus.
  • Background in engineering or strong technical fluency (e.g., able to discuss code, debug issues, or evaluate feasibility).
  • Experience managing CMS-based systems (e.g., Webflow or headless CMS) at scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across disciplines — engineering, SEO, design — and drive cross-functional alignment.
  • Highly analytical — able to define success metrics, pull data, and present insights to drive prioritization and decision-making.
  • Hands-on experience with modern product development practices: agile, Kanban, discovery frameworks, backlog grooming, etc.
  • Strong written communication skills. Clear PRDs and structured documentation are table stakes.

What’s in it for you?

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Non-working holidays per country of residence
  • Referral bonuses
  • Monthly internet stipend
  • Fun and casual work environment
  • Employee engagement activities and virtual gatherings
  • We are a diverse, global team!

Important Notice

To ensure the legitimacy of job opportunities, we strongly recommend that you solely rely on positions posted here on our official website: outliant.com/careers .

All our current job openings require video interviews conducted in either or both synchronous (via Google Meet) and asynchronous (via Willo) formats. Kindly refrain from accepting offers that appear suspicious. For any inquiries or concerns, feel free to reach out to us via email at .

Please be assured that we are fully committed to maintaining integrity in our hiring process.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Requisitos

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Canonical is hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. The role involves managing a distributed team across regions and coordinating with partners and communities to ensure high-quality kernels across supported releases.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and, with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices.

Responsibilities

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts; Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Clínica SAMMAR – Serviços Médicos Especializados é uma referência em saúde, oferecendo atendimento de excelência em diversas especialidades médicas. Localizada no Complexo Odonto-Médico Itaigara, no bairro do Itaigara em Salvador, a clínica se destaca nas áreas de Oftalmologia, Nutrição Pediátrica, Genética Médica, Hematologia Pediátrica, Gastroenterologia Pediátrica e Nutrologia.

Na Clínica SAMMAR, os pacientes encontram uma equipe altamente qualificada e dedicada, composta por especialistas renomados que utilizam as mais avançadas técnicas e tecnologias para proporcionar um atendimento personalizado e humanizado. O foco da clínica é garantir a saúde e o bem-estar dos pacientes, oferecendo diagnósticos precisos e tratamentos eficazes em um ambiente acolhedor e seguro.

As especialidades oferecidas incluem:

  • Oftalmologia: consultas de rotina e tratamentos especializados para diversas condições oculares
  • Nutrição Pediátrica e Nutrologia: orientação e acompanhamento para o crescimento e desenvolvimento saudáveis das crianças
  • Genética Médica: aconselhamento genético e testes específicos para identificar e tratar doenças hereditárias
  • Hematologia Pediátrica e Gastroenterologia Pediátrica: cuidados especializados para crianças com condições hematológicas e gastrointestinais

Escolher a Clínica SAMMAR é optar por um atendimento de qualidade, pautado pela ética e pelo compromisso com a saúde dos pacientes. A clínica está preparada para oferecer soluções integradas e eficientes, garantindo a melhor experiência em cuidados médicos especializados.

title: Gerente de engenharia de manutencao
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Com mais de 35 anos de atuação nacional, ajudamos empresas a proteger vidas por meio de soluções inovadoras em redes e dispositivos móveis de comunicação crítica, assegurando segurança e bem-estar.

A Alcon e a Kofre são empresas recém-integradas, atuando em soluções especializadas de tecnologia e telecomunicações para setores estratégicos, como mineração, energia e indústrias de grande porte.

Unidas, formam um grupo que combina inovação, confiabilidade e profundo conhecimento técnico, sempre com foco em entregar soluções de alto impacto, atendimento consultivo e geração de valor sustentável para seus clientes.

Nossos valores refletem o compromisso com excelência, integridade, colaboração e inovação constante, guiando nosso trabalho em um mercado dinâmico e desafiador.

Sobre a Função

Nesta posição, você será responsável por liderar a estratégia de manutenção e a confiabilidade dos ativos de telecomunicações e rede, desde sistemas de rádio comunicação até a otimização dos processos operacionais. Seu desafio será garantir a alta disponibilidade dos equipamentos de missão crítica, liderar iniciativas de automatização de processo e rotinas, e implementar metodologias de excelência operacional que assegurem ganhos de eficiência, redução de custos e produtividade sustentável.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a gestão da estratégia de manutenção seja preditiva, preventiva e corretiva de ativos de rádio comunicação, LTE e infraestrutura de sites, assegurando a alta disponibilidade e a conformidade com as normas e contratos;
  • Conduzir tecnicamente o time de especialistas responsáveis por garantir a aderência aos requisitos e padrões técnicos, regulatórios (Anatel) e de segurança;
  • Implementar metodologias de confiabilidade de ativos e gerir os indicadores como manutenção e performance, como AMS, APM, DF, MTDF e outros;
  • Desenvolver controles das áreas de operação e manutenção como: Controle de custos, gestão absolecência, gestão de riscos, gestão de KPI s técnicos e financeiros de manutenção, e outros;
  • Conduzir análises de falhas (RCA e planos de contingência específicos para equipamentos de telecom, promovendo a segurança e a continuidade do negócio;
  • Avaliar e aprovar tecnicamente investimentos (CAPEX) equilibrando custos do ciclo de vida, riscos operacionais e perfomance da rede.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia e manutenção de ativos (telecom, automação, elétrica e instrumentação), com atuação em redes de rádio comunicação e/ou LTDA;
  • Experiência como gestor de pessoas, conduzindo times multidisciplinares e projetos de alta complexidade;
  • Domínio em metodologias de confiabilidade de ativos, análise de falhas e gestão de projetos;
  • Vivência em área industrial nas áreas de engenharia e manutenção de máquinas, equipamentos e infraestrutura de tecnologia;
  • Inglês nível intermediário.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Habilidade para guiar e motivar a equipe durante a reestruturação e a implementação de novas metodologias;
  • Visão Analitica e Orientada a Dados;
  • Gestão de Pessoas.

Diferenciais

  • Formação em Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Automação e Elétrica;
  • Especialização em Engenharia de Manutenção.

Benefícios

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Ticket Alimentação / Refeição
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Benefícios Flexíveis
  • Total Pass / Programas de Saúde e Bem Estar
  • Trilhas de Desenvolvimento de Talentos
  • Day Off

title: Sales Enablement Specialist
description:
Job overview

Provide hands-on support for successful opportunity management within the growing IQVIA Cronos Rater Services GTM team.

Cronos is part of the Applied Patient Experience Solutions team (APEx) within IQVIA Patient Centered Solutions (PCS). PCS partners with clients to help design and execute clinical trials centered around patients as well as products. They provide solutions that measure, analyze, and improve patient experience in trials, and support drug regulatory approval.

Key functions

  • Support triage process with initial report review, monitoring of mailbox and information collation and status updates for CNS opportunities; acting as deputy to triage lead

  • Coordinate Cronos opportunity BD strategy calls

  • Ensure GTM team have right information for, and deliver, quality proposals on time, assisting with content where required/applicable to aid completion

  • Enforce and maintain proposal library to increase GTM knowledge base of indications and COA nuances in collaboration with Cronos GTM team, Scale Management lead and (GBO proposals team) to help inform content for proposals and tracking of existing opportunities and pricing

  • Coordinate change order log and drive assignment and development of supporting budget, proposal and contracting process liaising with required teams through to completion

  • Regularly review market analysis of drug and study pipeline for potential high priority compounds/companies to inform CI feeds and targeting activity

  • Support GTM team strengthening collaborations with IQVIA stakeholder teams and coordination of meetings, updates, collateral etc

  • Support with maintenance of sales pipeline updates on Salesforce and reporting

  • Assist with evolution of triage/opportunity trackers to ensure scalable and easy to maintain

  • Assist with building processes and collateral for additional services as we scale

  • Work with GTM and Operations teams to ensure the right processes are in place and adhered to for effective handover of won projects to facilitate a smooth start up.

Skills and qualifications

  • Relevant bachelor’s degree (e.g. Biology, Psychology, Pharmacy, Business Administration or other related field)

  • Knowledge of IQVIA and clinical research industry preferred

  • Interest in CNS disorders and awareness of clinician administered outcome assessments

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and Salesforce (preferred)

  • Fluency communication in English - the role will be conducted in English and working with colleagues/sectors worldwide

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, project management, organizational and customer service skills

  • Experience in meeting facilitation, presentation, and training

  • Ability to develop and maintain relationships in a diverse business environment

  • Be proactive and work well as part of a team and be flexible to changing needs of rapidly expanding business.

*CV must be submitted/attached in English *

title: Inside Sales Representative (Creative Specialist)
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Inside Sales Representative (Creative Specialist) role at THE/STUDIO . THE/STUDIO is a remote-first company with a global team and a vision to empower individuals to unleash creativity through custom product production. All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, with a fast, stable internet connection.

We help creators and brands bring product ideas to life, from custom hats to packaging. Our Creative Specialists are the first touchpoint for customers, turning curiosity into orders.

Why you’ll love this role: you’ll join a fast-growing global team, hit sales targets, and empower customers to improve their manufacturing capabilities through our platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Connect with inbound leads and uncover customer goals through curiosity-driven conversations.
  • Guide customers through design, pricing, and production options with confidence and creativity.
  • Manage pipeline in HubSpot with speed, accuracy, and ownership.
  • Handle objections and position THE/STUDIO as the best alternative to “cheap but risky” sourcing options.
  • Collaborate with the Sales Team Lead and Manager to improve processes and hit team-wide revenue goals.
  • Act as the bridge between customers and Production/Design teams to ensure smooth orders and accurate design execution.
  • Oversee product tracking, delivery, and post-sales support, building long-term customer relationships.
  • Consistently meet KPIs and sales targets while driving repeat business.
  • Maintain accurate daily reports and trackers for alignment and accountability.

Within the Role – Timeline Milestones

  • Within 1 month: learn THE/STUDIO’s value proposition, get integrated with the team, and close your first inbound deal.
  • Within 3 months: proactively offer customers custom options, maintain CRM hygiene, and support design processes.
  • Within 6 months: identify new tools/methods, build a list of repeat customers, and aim for strong year-end performance and potential promotion.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of quota-carrying sales experience (recent).
  • Experience in product sales, ideally in high-velocity or SMB markets.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills (C1 minimum).
  • Coachable, curious, and resilient—able to adapt quickly.
  • High energy, professional communication style, and strong video presence.
  • Passion for sales and interest in the apparel or manufacturing industry.
  • Knowledge of Adobe Illustrator and comfort collaborating with design teams.
  • Organized digital presence (LinkedIn, CRM, calendar); HubSpot familiarity is a plus.
  • Self-starter, detail-oriented, and solution-driven.
  • Comfortable working remotely with a reliable setup and availability for US hours (PST).
  • Remote-ready: owns a desktop/laptop with at least 8GB RAM, stable internet, and a quiet space for meetings.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Fast-growing company redefining custom manufacturing with high-quality inbound leads.
  • Transparent metrics and dashboards for performance.
  • Supportive, feedback-driven culture with growth opportunities for top performers.
  • Competitive compensation + uncapped commissions; Independent Contractor role.
  • Personalized sales training for your future career; no micromanagement.

Company Values

  • Intellectually curious; asks questions and seeks to understand deeply.
  • Self-motivated with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence.
  • Good communication skills for remote collaboration and timely feedback.
  • Radical candor; coachable and able to give constructive feedback.
  • Urgency; quick decision-making and problem-solving in a dynamic environment.
  • Natural customer centricity; always consider the customer perspective.
  • Results-driven; focuses on measurable objectives.

Hiring Process

  • Submit an application (resume in English).
  • Initial chat with Global Recruiter.
  • Hiring Manager Interview.
  • Assessment/Case Study (if applicable).
  • Final Interview.
  • Note: process may vary by role; candidates are informed via email.

Equal Opportunity Statement: THE/STUDIO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to fair, inclusive, and equitable hiring practices. No third-party recruiters/agencies, please.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Information Technology Manager at Ledn. Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders and build generational wealth for the future.

Ledn offers a suite of lending, savings, and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values integrity, progress, and empathy.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The role requires wearing many hats, including end-user support, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right candidate will have demonstrated success in similar roles within fast-growing, security-first environments and will be passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will design, implement, and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks and collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholders across the organization.

You will be customer-facing and serve as the first line of support for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira. This role involves procuring and delivering technology equipment, managing onboarding and offboarding, and documenting programs, policies, and tooling. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoints and MDM/EMM tools. You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools and write knowledge articles and automations. You will manage incidents and priorities, participate in agile sprints, and align objectives with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc., and to integrate APIs across systems.
  • Experience with SSO (Okta) and IAM workflows; familiarity with remote support across time zones.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and articles; customer-focused and able to handle frustrated users calmly.
  • Proficiency with macOS in an enterprise environment, troubleshooting, and terminal usage.
  • Experience with security practices, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs), and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and collaborate across multiple teams.
  • Nice-to-have: AWS familiarity, GAM and CLI tooling, Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications, and experience in a remote/high-growth setting.

Culture and Qualities

  • Leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment, with integrity, accountability, empathy, and a builder mindset.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and delivering results in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures.

Benefits and Environment

  • Comprehensive total rewards package, generous PTO, and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work opportunity for up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • Equal opportunity employer; inclusive culture; accommodation requests available during recruitment.

Additional Information

Ledn operates globally with a remote-first approach. Due to high application volumes, qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response. No agencies or recruiters, and no unsolicited resumes.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated experience in similar roles within rapidly growing, security-first environments, and a passion for automation and infrastructure as code.

title: Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Canonical has a large and rapidly growing kernel team that underpins Ubuntu and open source more widely across a very wide range of hardware and use cases. We partner with the biggest kernel contributors - the silicon companies - to ensure that their work reaches the widest possible audience as quickly as possible, with a 10 year enterprise security commitment.

The Canonical Linux Kernel Organization has teams in every time zone. We have opportunities for technical leadership, engineering management, and engineering directorships. The team is responsible for all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels, on all platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large scale cloud environments, mainframes and supercomputers.

We care most about hardware and virtualization enablement, security, reliability and performance. There are a number of areas where we lead upstream, but for the most part we are interested in ensuring production readiness and performance for the latest patch-sets, rather than subsystem maintenance or evolution.

Kernel Team projects include but are not limited to:

  • Ubuntu Linux kernel plan, execution, benchmarking and stress testing
  • Optimized kernels for key silicon and cloud partners
  • Confidential computing and next-generation security primitives
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Kernel Livepatch, which delivers critical kernel fixes without rebooting
  • FIPS compliance
  • Real-Time and Low Latency kernel variants and patch-sets
  • Virtualization or abstraction engines
  • Container technology
  • Security with AppArmor, SECCOMP, namespaces and more
  • Networking - in particular performance and security
  • Storage - we are particularly interested in Ceph and DRBD

We hire candidates of all experience levels from recent university graduates through seasoned industry experts. We select those who are enthusiastic to work in multiple areas including security mitigation, feature development, patching and test. You must have outstanding academic results, a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and – with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan – have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.

What the role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of a flavour of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Solid background with git
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Understanding of Linux kernel upstream processes and release cycle
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Solid background in CI/CD and process automation
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated experience in similar roles within rapidly growing, security-first environments. The role emphasizes automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, with a focus on designing, implementing and managing our cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR) and report to the Director of IT. The position is customer-facing, focused on providing an outstanding IT support experience for employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We primarily operate on macOS devices.

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line IT support for employees, trouble-shooting and resolving issues via macOS environments; manage help desk tickets and prioritize tasks.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; oversee onboarding for new employees and offboarding equipment for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and policies, and contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management (MDM/EMM) tooling (Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and improve identity and access management (IDP/SSO tools such as G Suite, Okta) and integrate systems via APIs.
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks; manage incidents to resolution.
  • Work on projects across sprints using Jira and agile methods; set and align objectives and key results with team and company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Proficiency in automation with bash/zsh/python; experience with open-source tools (Nudge, CIS benchmarks, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Experience integrating SSO (Okta) and APIs; remote support across multiple countries/time zones; hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically; strong documentation skills.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI model; ability to diagnose and troubleshoot methodically.
  • Self-management with the ability to scope projects and collaborate across teams; comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
  • Nice to have: familiarity with AWS, GAM, Jamf/Okta/Google Cloud certifications; experience working in a remote environment.

Benefits and Culture

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Inclusive, diverse team with a commitment to integrity, progress and empathy; remote-first environment.

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn\'s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data. Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.) You\'ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

title: Especialista de Transporte, Sort Center
description:
Overview

Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil - F95

O SC (Sort Center) está em busca de profissionais engajados e apaixonados por inovação para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial, garantindo entregas dentro do prazo e com a máxima eficiência de custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é operar com excelência, otimizando capacidades e monitorando em tempo real as operações do Sort Center no Brasil, realizando o acompanhamento hora a hora e fornecendo análises detalhadas dos dados operacionais.

Essa posição requer um profissional proativo e com espírito de liderança. Você representará uma posição estratégica nas operações de transporte da Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos constantemente para melhorar os níveis de serviço, a eficiência das capacidades e a otimização dos custos do Sort Center Brasil. Isso garantirá que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas de forma consistente.

Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento FCs / ATS Middle Mile / TOM e AMZL, garantindo que nossas capacidades sejam sempre atingidas com excelência e ainda garantindo a visibilidade dessas capacidades para as áreas parceiras e para a gerência sênior da operação.

Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de resolver problemas com agilidade, utilizando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões assertivas em tempo real. É essencial compreender os requisitos, analisar dados, identificar tendências e impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem impactar os prazos estabelecidos. Conhecimentos básicos em logística e habilidades de comunicação claras, tanto na forma escrita quanto oral, são indispensáveis. Além disso, o profissional deve propor melhorias nos processos e ter a determinação de implementá-las até a conclusão.

Essa posição estará envolvida na expansão do Sort Center no Brasil, trabalhando em turnos de 3x2. Modelo de trabalho: Presencial, em turnos pela escala 3x2. É necessário ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários/turnos/áreas flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana, noites e/ou feriados.

Key job responsibilities

  • Estabelecer comunicação eficiente com clientes externos (ATS Middle Mile, TOM, Time de Operações do Sort Center e AMZL) e clientes internos (centros de atendimento ROC, estações de entrega);
  • Possuir capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é um diferencial desejável;
  • Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho relevantes para impulsionar os resultados do negócio;
  • Entender rapidamente o impacto das tendências nos resultados comerciais e tomar decisões com base nos dados disponíveis;
  • Encaminhar de forma estruturada problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes, garantindo a execução de soluções;
  • Trabalhar dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, mensurando e identificando as atividades realizadas;
  • Responder pelo gerenciamento de capacidade de linha e gerenciamento de volume, incluindo a realização de uploads de limites de capacidade no sistema;
  • Garantir visibilidade às atividades de Capacidades, fornecendo suporte direto ao time de operações.

A day in the life

O Sort Center é o Middle Mile (MM), uma parte da estrutura da Amazon Transportation Service (ATS), onde os pacotes são enviados para serem consolidados de diferentes origens e serem classificados e enviados ao destino para melhorar a velocidade de entrega, a ocupação do veículo e a frequência da rota. A estratégia do Sort Center para o Brasil tem como objetivo desenvolver nossa rede de transporte apoiando a expansão dos programas da AMZL, Amazon Air e Market Place.

Como líder de equipe, você supervisionará uma de nossas estações de entrega, fornecendo liderança aos associados e gerenciando o desempenho dos principais indicadores – Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Você assumirá muitas funções e trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que de uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. A função envolve:

Responsabilidades

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com as diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  • Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.
  • Envolver-se com funções de suporte e/ou outros departamentos para abordar problemas ou necessidades comuns de indicadores de desempenho, por exemplo, processos de readiness, 5S, segurança, treinamento.
  • Monitoramento do andamento das rotas, atuando de forma proativa para identificar e corrigir desvios e adequar, com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Condução de reuniões, atribuição de funções e supervisão de atividades ligadas a KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia (On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success) e aprimoramento do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Ficar obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para impulsionar as melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento / implementação de sistemas / processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir as operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar as métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Observação: Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. At MonetizeMore, we’re all about using data to transform how the advertising industry tackles IVT (Invalid Traffic) and fraud prevention. Our products deliver real impact—and we need top-tier talent to help sell this premium AI product to better protect ad monetized publishers and ad tech vendors.

For 15 years, we’ve been driven by a team of 100+ talented professionals across the globe. As a 100% remote and culture-centric organization, we are built on the core pillars of Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen, ensuring excellence in everything we do.

About The Role

MonetizeMore is seeking an Ad Tech Developer with in-depth expertise in header bidding to build, optimize, and scale programmatic monetization for premium publishers. You’ll own end-to-end header bidding implementations (with a heavy focus on Prebid.js), improve auction performance, and partner with product, yield, and publisher success teams to deliver revenue-lifting results with excellent user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Design & implement header bidding stacks using Prebid.js (web) and related wrappers; configure bidders, floors, price granularity, userId modules, and analytics
  • Customize & extend adapters/modules (e.g., userId, analytics, consent) and contribute clean, documented JavaScript/TypeScript code
  • Integrate with GAM/Ad Manager (GPT): line item strategy, key-values, creative templates, and troubleshooting of delivery and competition
  • Optimize auctions & latency: tune timeouts, s2s vs. client, floors, ad refresh logic, and page performance (CLS/LCP/INP/Core Web Vitals)
  • Run experiments: A/B test bidders, formats, and page placements; build dashboards to track impact (e.g., eCPM, viewability, fill, latency)
  • Debug complex issues across browser, network, and auction layers (DevTools, HAR/Waterfall, Charles/Proxyman); resolve revenue dips & bidder errors
  • Implement privacy & compliance: IAB TCF, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, CMP integration, consent storage, and geo-specific behaviors
  • Work with partners: SSPs, exchanges, ID providers, and analytics vendors to launch new demand and troubleshoot
  • Ship quality safely: use Git, CI/CD, code review, and observability to keep releases fast and reliable
  • Document & mentor: write clear runbooks and help level up teammates

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–6+ years of front-end or full-stack experience with a strong JavaScript foundation (TypeScript a plus)
  • 2–4+ years hands-on with header bidding (Prebid.js required); experience with s2s/managed wrappers (e.g., Prebid Server, Amazon TAM/UAM) is a plus
  • Solid understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM/GPT) setups, line items & creatives, key-values, targeting, and delivery debugging
  • Working knowledge of programmatic concepts: OpenRTB, floors, auction dynamics, user sync/ID, brand safety, and viewability
  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks & CMPs (IAB TCF v2.x, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) and consent-aware ad serving
  • Performance tuning for Core Web Vitals and modern build tools (Webpack/Vite/Rollup)
  • Comfort with Chrome DevTools, network waterfalls, and log-driven debugging; bonus points for Node.js, Cloud Functions, or simple backend endpoints
  • Data fluency: basic SQL or BI tools (Looker/Data Studio/BigQuery) for revenue & latency analysis
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; bias for automation and measurable outcomes

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app/webview monetization, AMP, or SPA frameworks (React/Vue/Svelte)
  • Prebid analytics adapters or custom reporting pipelines
  • Experience with ads.txt/app-ads.txt, sellers.json, supply chain object
  • Knowledge of brand safety & IVT controls, creative QA, and MRC viewability standards
  • Exposure to video (IMA/OMSDK, Prebid Video, VAST/VPAID/VMAP) or CTV/OTT
  • Knowledge in Python and NoSQL is a plus

Why MonetizeMore

  • Remote-first culture with flexible work hours
  • Impact at scale across a large publisher network
  • Smart, low-ego teammates and a culture of experimentation
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, home-office stipend, and learning budget

MonetizeMore is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from diverse candidates.

title: Security Engineer
description:
About Ledn

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is diverse and united by a conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews; define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services; automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD; conduct threat modeling and risk assessments; partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications; enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger MFA solutions (WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens); align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows; define secure session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads; integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments; ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services with least-privilege IAM and secure key management; improve Kubernetes security posture; deploy and operate a SIEM framework with detection rules and incident playbooks; support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001).

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale information security practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package that starts on day one, including equity ownership in Ledn.
  • Remote-friendly work arrangement with global teams; opportunity to work remotely up to 180 days per year where permitted.
  • Comprehensive benefits and a purpose-driven career in the digital asset space.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusivity. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals. You may reach out to accommodate requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Ledn is global and remote-first, with team members across North America, Latin America, Europe, and Africa. Due to high application volume, only qualified candidates will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.
