title: Operating Partner
description:
Overview

An operating partner is a business leader who works with a company's leadership team to improve the business and create value for shareholders. They are often a key part of a firm's investment strategy and act as a liaison between the firm and its portfolio company. Their responsibilities can include:

  • Advising and coaching — Working with the CEO and management team to provide perspectives and recommendations.
  • Analyzing challenges — Identifying areas for improvement and developing plans to increase efficiency and growth.
  • Creating strategies — Developing plans to increase profits and cash flow, and implement operational best practices.
  • Monitoring performance — Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial performance.
  • Facilitating value creation — Ensuring the portfolio company has the resources to meet the firm's investment goals.
  • Supporting growth — Assisting with planning, forecasting, and due diligence to support company growth and expansion.
  • Building reporting — Creating simple, consistent reporting that makes it easy to identify when the company is off-track.
  • Leadership — To run a company you must be a leader. Full stop - no excuses. We are looking for Operating Partners who are natural born leaders.

What is the Cache Operating Partner Program?

The Cache Operating Partner Program is your opportunity to partner with Cache as the incoming CEO/COO/VP/GM/President of a newly acquired portfolio company.

Our Operating Partners are experienced leaders and operators currently working within a Software as a Service or Service-Based businesses in a sales, marketing, operations, or key management role. If you have a demonstrable track record of success and are looking to run an internet-based business as its operating CEO/COO/VP/GM/President we’d love to hear from you.

Applying as an Operating Partner puts you in our network for consideration when we acquire new businesses generating $500K-$5M in revenue. Operating Partners should expect excellent and unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.

Our Strategy

  • Plug & Play Systems — We use our proven playbooks to create and curate a database full of potential customers and invest in bringing value to them on an ongoing basis.
  • Remote Workforce — With a global footprint, we operate with a distributed team covering multiple time zones capable of serving our multinational customer base.
  • Winning Spirit — We bring a creative solutions mindset to problem-solving. No defeat, be optimistic. Pretty much everything is fixable, and most decisions are reversible.
  • Bunts & Singles — Narrow down the market to a specific customer that we can be the best at serving, and grow from there.

Our Thesis

There are intelligent entrepreneurs globally that are adept at identifying and building great software. Once these companies reach product-market-fit, it’s not uncommon for the company to grow beyond the founders’ core competencies.

By infusing capital and adding infrastructure, we can enable businesses to realize their full potential while continuing to scale the revenue profitably.

Our Focus

We seek to minimize risk and maximize returns, meaning we only invest in companies with a clear predictable path to success.

We will consider all types of business software and service companies, and specifically focus on the following:

  • Enterprise Software
  • SMB Software
  • Vertical Market Software
  • Tech Enabled Managed Services
  • IT Consulting
  • Ecommerce Software

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational leadership experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing direct and/or indirect reports.
  • Extensive knowledge in operations, including resource planning, demand planning, business planning, corporate strategy, communications, leadership, benchmarking, and forecasting.
  • Required skills in market research, analytics, financial modeling, metrics analysis, and presentations.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Must be results-oriented and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, capable of interacting with all levels of associates with tact and diplomacy.
  • Proven ability to protect confidential information.
  • Ability to travel by automobile and aircraft, with the flexibility to be away from home for extended periods.
  • Experience in managing external relations, including identifying, diversifying, building, and maintaining relationships with community organizations and leaders to secure various forms of support and partnerships.
  • Ability to manage solicitations with board members and sponsors, provide outcome reports, and lead cultivation and stewardship activities for charitable endeavors.
  • Unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.
  • Competitive Health, Dental, and Vision benefits.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing, the first line of support; own support, and provide an outstanding support experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.
  • Troubleshoot, use the terminal, and make macOS work in the enterprise.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding experience for all new employees and the retrieval process for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets with project work; work in sprints and document progress in Jira (adhere to agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS (no certifications required).
  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Have a passion for progress; adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder’s mindset; eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially with confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company; equity through shared ownership.
  • Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (restrictions apply).
  • A career with purpose; we remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer; inclusive and diverse, with success from diversity.

Application and Environment

  • You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.
  • Ledn is a globally distributed, remote-first team spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
  • As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.
  • No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Overview

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.

Responsibilities

  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Monitor real-time campaign performance and proactively adjust bids, budgets, and targeting to improve efficiency and results.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

title: Digital Media Planner/Buyer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.

Media Planning & Strategy

  • Develop comprehensive media plans aligned with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct in-depth research and analysis to identify optimal media channels and strategies.
  • Determine budget allocation across channels based on performance and objectives.
  • Stay abreast of emerging digital media trends, technologies, and AI integrations.
  • Advise the New Business teams and Account teams on recommended budgets and media strategies during the pitch process.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns across various platforms (e.g., Google Ads, social media platforms, programmatic display).
  • Manage relationships with external vendors responsible for day-to-day campaign management.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
  • Analyze campaign performance data to identify areas for optimization and improvement. Generate regular reports on campaign performance and insights.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.).
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

Responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing logistics activities related to international trade operations (imports and exports), third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse management, and national deliveries. This role ensures cost efficiency, on-time performance, and high-quality customer service throughout the supply chain.

Responsibilities

International Trade Coordination

  • Supervise all import and export processes, including documentation management, customs clearance, and compliance with trade regulations
  • Coordinate with customs brokers, international carriers, and customs authorities

3PL Warehouse Management

Domestic Distribution Planning

  • Organize and supervise national distribution, including route planning and delivery schedules
  • Coordinate with carriers and logistics partners to ensure on-time and complete deliveries (OTD)
  • Manage transportation documentation and follow up on deliveries through to customer confirmation

Cost and Process Optimization

  • Analyze and optimize logistics costs related to storage, transportation, and customs
  • Propose and implement continuous improvements in distribution, warehousing, and trade operations
  • Negotiate rates and service terms with logistics and freight providers

Operational Monitoring and Control

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs): delivery times, route compliance, service levels, inventory turnover, etc.
  • Prepare logistics performance reports and present findings to senior management
  • Manage and resolve logistics incidents, including delays, product damage, returns, and losses

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate closely with purchasing, sales, customer service, and finance departments to align logistics operations with business goals
  • Communicate delivery timelines, operational constraints, and critical updates to internal teams and customers

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, International Trade, or related fields
  • 3–5 years of experience in logistics coordination roles, including international trade, 3PL operations, and national distribution
  • Knowledge of import/export processes and customs regulations
  • Proficiency in Incoterms, tariff classification, and trade agreements
  • Advanced English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with TMS and ERP systems – SAP / TOTVS Datasul

Preferred Requirements

  • Certification or diploma in logistics, supply chain management, or international trade
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with logistics cost analysis and KPI management
  • Operational leadership and strategic planning abilities
  • Problem-solving in logistics and supply chain environments
  • Effective communication and negotiation skills
  • Adaptability and stress management in dynamic contexts

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Security Engineers, Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Ledn offers a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is a diverse group united by the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy, and Ledn’s products & services can play a critical role in doing so. Our core values are integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services and invite you to join us.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will also design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

What You Will Do

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams; define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services; automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD; conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features; partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications; enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens); collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows; define secure session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads; integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments; ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services with least-privilege IAM and secure key management; improve Kubernetes security posture; deploy and operate a SIEM framework with detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks; support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • Minimum 10 years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals; ability to remediate vulnerabilities identified in penetration test reports.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Experience on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Be adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale information security practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.

title: Solutions architect remoto
description:
Resumo

A Verity está buscando novos talentos! Somos uma boutique para modernização e aceleração digital e buscamos Solutions Architect para fazer parte dessa jornada.

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.
  • Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.
  • Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).
  • Detalhar os requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definir métricas claras para cada um.
  • Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.
  • Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.
  • Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.
  • Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).
  • Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).
  • Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.
  • Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).
  • Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.
  • Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).
  • Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).
  • Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.
  • Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando entendimento de prós e contras.
  • Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).
  • Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.
  • Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa e criar diagramas que a representem, incluindo componentes, interações e fluxos de dados.

Documentação e Apresentação

  • Centralizar documentações (Readme).
  • Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.
  • Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.
  • Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação

  • Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.
  • Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.
  • Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.
  • Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.
  • Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).
  • Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a microsserviços.
  • Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).
  • Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).
  • Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).
  • Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.
  • Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em trade-offs envolvidos.
  • Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

  • Seguro de vida
  • Parcerias de descontos

title: Sr. Clinical Operations Lead (LATAM)
description:
Overview

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Responsible for the clinical operations of a project within a defined regional/global level. Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations. The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team. Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions. The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight

  • Overall oversight of (a group of) regional CRAs to ensure (site) compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.
  • Monitoring support visits (Co-monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site/CRA in the satisfactory performance and compliance with standards mentioned above.
  • May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.g. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)
  • Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities.
  • Assist in vendor management activities as required per project.
  • Perform review of visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management.
  • Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan.
  • Proactive management of site and country performance (recruitment, data collection, document collection, TMF review etc.) and inform clinical project team on progress.
  • Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable. May include but may not be limited to input on revenue recognition, site payments, and site pass-through expense review.
  • May be required to manage/oversee investigator sites including CRA responsibilities, on a temporary or permanent basis.

Project Liaison

  • Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, as well as individual/country CRA calls
  • Attend meetings with Study Sponsor to provide status updates on country and site progress
  • Provide operational support and guidance to the monitoring team throughout project.
  • Provide project training/mentoring to regional CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans and guidelines, and timelines for the study. Ensures study specific training requirements are completed and documented.
  • First point of contact for regional CRAs for study-specific questions and issues. Escalates to PM and other functions as appropriate.
  • Support line managers by providing status updates on utilization and performance of CRAs.
  • Liaise with line manager for assigning sites to CRAs following line manager allocation of a CRA resource to the project.
  • Conduct CRA Assessment visits per departmental requirements to assess the performance of the CRA against their monitoring responsibilities.

Study Documents and Plans

  • Develop training materials and study tools for sites and CRAs, including monitoring plans.
  • Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies together with clinical project team.
  • Develop presentation materials for and presents at Sponsor Kickoff meetings, Investigator meetings and Sponsor Calls (as needed), and prepares presentations for Site Qualification Visits and Site Initiation Visits.

Qualifications

  • College diploma/degree AND 7-9 years related experience +continuous training and knowledge/skills upgrading
  • OR Undergraduate university degree (Bachelors or Honors Bachelors) AND 4-6 years’ experience + substantial on-going job-related training

Other

  • Health Sciences, Life Sciences or Nursing specialty preferred, or SoCRA and/or ACRP Certification/Designation.
  • Should have a minimum of 3 years CRA experience, have strong experience with EDC systems, be proficient with MS Office, have strong written and verbal communication skills and highly effective interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrate the following attributes: proactive, detail oriented, task-driven and highly organized.
  • Demonstrate the critical elements of GCPs and local regulations as they relate to clinical monitoring, IRB/EC and Investigator responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated ability in report writing and strong ability to critically understand clinical research documents.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Working Conditions

  • Home-based

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role:

We’re partnering with an innovative early-stage company revolutionizing pet health through smart, connected technology. Their product is a next-generation collar-mounted device that leverages IoT and AI to monitor pet activity, wellness, and location in real-time — helping both pet parents and veterinarians take proactive care decisions.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our Firmware team. If you’re passionate about low-level development and excited to shape the future of pet tech, this role is for you.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience developing embedded firmware for IoT devices .
  • Deep expertise in C for embedded systems.
  • 3+ years of experience with BLE modules (Nordic, STM, Silabs, or Ambiq).
  • 3+ years of experience with Wi-Fi modules (TI, Qualcomm, Espressif, or Realtek).
  • Proficient in using version control tools and familiar with Clean Code principles and unit testing .

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with LTE and GNSS technologies.
  • Familiarity with MEMS sensors .
  • Working knowledge of Python for scripting or automation.

title: SDR Pleno
description:
Overview

SOBRE A BUZZCREATORS
A Buzzcreators é uma plataforma brasileira especializada em conectar marcas com influenciadores, especialmente micro e nano influenciadores, para a criação e gestão de campanhas de marketing de influência. Ela oferece uma solução automatizada e baseada em dados para facilitar todo o processo, desde o planejamento até a execução e pagamento das campanhas.

Vaga - 100% HOME OFFICE

O que buscamos

O SDR em vendas (Sales Development Representative, ou Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas) terá a responsabilidade de identificar e qualificar leads, estabelecer contatos, criar oportunidades de negócio e auxiliar os times comerciais. Além disso, atuará na etapa pré-vendas, com habilidades específicas, antes de as vendas começarem.

Atividades

  • Prospecção ativa 100% focada em Outbound de empresas e agências interessadas e com potencial para se tornarem clientes Buzzmonitor;
  • Compreensão das necessidades/dores de negócio do cliente;
  • Apresentação de plataforma para solucionar essas necessidades;
  • Mapeamento de necessidades e potenciais projetos.

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino superior em andamento ou completo;
  • Experiência na posição de SDR/Inside Sales;
  • Experiência com metodologia de venda BANT;
  • Experiência com Google Docs ou Microsoft Office;
  • Experiência com processo outbound;
  • Experiência com criação de listas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Técnica de vendas: Spin Selling;
  • Prospecção ABM;
  • Experiência no setor de Marketing Digital;
  • Experiência com Atendimento (SAC 4.0);
  • Experiência com tecnologia ou software SaaS;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de captação de cliente e validação de email (Sales Engagement).

description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

We’re looking for a Senior Solutions & Product Architect (Deputy CTO) to join our leadership team and scale alongside our cofounder & CTO. This is a client-facing, high-impact role that blends product strategy, solution architecture, and delivery leadership .

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with clients from day one to understand their business needs and shape solutions.
  • Define high-level product requirements, MVP scopes, and roadmaps.
  • Translate business goals into technical architectures and delivery plans.

  • Oversee delivery across multiple teams, ensuring quality and accountability.
  • Be a trusted advisor to clients, while mentoring engineering teams internally.
  • Help codify Oowlish’s playbooks so we can scale beyond any single leader.

Must Have:

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or product/technical consulting.
  • Strong technical breadth (cloud, APIs, modern architectures).
  • Proven ability to lead multiple teams/projects and communicate with C-level stakeholders.
  • Experience defining product requirements and MVPs , not just technical designs.
  • Excellent communication skills (English required; Spanish/Portuguese a plus ).
  • Backgrounds that could be a great fit:
  • Experience in consulting / outsourcing firms.
  • CTOs or co-founders of startups, with hands-on experience balancing product, tech, and business.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and excited to grow into a future CTO/Partner role.

Benefits & Perks:

Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

Você é apaixonado por alcançar metas, está motivado a superar desafios e se colocar no lugar do outro enquanto faz parte de uma equipe dinâmica? Aqui é o seu lugar!!

Buscamos nos conectar com pessoas e aqui a gente preza pela igualdade de oportunidades e a inclusão da diversidade para todos os públicos. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Agente de solução em atendimento Multiskill via voz, ticket, e-mail e chat do e-commerce de uma rede de marcas de roupa de grife e calçados;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência com atendimento em SAC de vestuário/e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento básico no ramo da moda;
  • Possuir agilidade, escrita e dicção boa;
  • Experiência com atendimento em multicanais – voz, chat e e-mail;
  • Possuir habilidades em atuar no modelo home office;
  • Ter um espaço adequado para atuar home office (Mesa, cadeira e ambiente sem ruído);
  • Residir em São Paulo/ Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencial em escritório no bairro Vila Olímpia sempre que requerido pela empresa/liderança;
  • Possuir internet cabeada com mais de 10 MB (Sem utilizar o Wifi);

Fornecemos Notebook, Mouse e Headset.

title: Manipulador de Saneantes
description:
Job description


A OSID – Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce é uma das maiores instituições filantrópicas do país, com cerca de 5,6 milhões de procedimentos ambulatoriais por ano, na Bahia, a usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais, pessoas em situação de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social.


A entidade conta com um perfil de serviços único no Brasil, distribuídos em 21 núcleos que prestam assistência à população de baixa renda nas áreas de Saúde, Assistência Social, Pesquisa Científica, Ensino em Saúde, Educação e na preservação e difusão da história de sua fundadora, Santa Dulce dos Pobres.



Main responsibilities



  • Dispensar saneantes via comunicado interno e/ou solicitação via MV;

  • Controlar temperatura do ambiente;

  • Auxiliar na realização de inventários periódicos dos produtos estocados;

  • Controlar saneantes segregando do estoque produtos vencidos e informando ao coordenador de setor produtos com vencimento próximo;

  • Realizar acuracidade diária dos produtos do estoque;

  • Conferir e controlar a entrada e saída de produtos do estoque;

  • Manter a ordem e limpeza das prateleiras, caixas plásticas, pallets, carrinhos, armários e estações de trabalho;

  • Coletar e separar diariamente as bombonas vazias de saneantes nos setores destino;

  • Realizar a limpeza de bombonas e almotolias;

  • Preenchimento diário de protocolos e ficha técnica de manipulação dos saneantes diluídos;

  • Preparar a etiqueta de cada produto diluído na central de diluição e rotular toda a produção;

  • Diluir e envasar os saneantes em almotolias e bombonas e entregar nos setores destino.



Requirements and skills



  • Ensino médio completo;

  • 06 meses de experiência em cargos similares.



Additional information



  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;

  • Vale transporte;

  • Alimentação no refeitório da empresa.

Coordenador Comercial – responsável por liderar a equipe de vendas, definir estratégias de mercado e alcançar metas de faturamento.

  • Coordenar a equipe de call center e atendimento multicanal (WhatsApp, Instagram, telefone, leads digitais).

  • Conhecimento em captação de leads ativos e receptivos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de atendimento (WhatsApp Business, CRMs, plataformas de call center).

  • Desejável experiência em clínicas, hospitais ou segmento de saúde.

Sobre a empresa:

A empresa cuida da Saúde ocular das pessoas, com excelência técnica, acolhimento, tecnologia de ponta e valores justos. Tendo como visão ser o hospital oftalmológico mais confiável da Bahia, reconhecido pela tecnologia, acolhimento e resultados que transformam vidas. Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev® é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício. Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global. Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.

Líder de Análise de Dados na BairesDev

Estamos à procura de um Líder de Análise de Dados para se juntar à nossa equipe. Esse profissional será responsável por manter a integridade do nosso processo de dados, incluindo originação, aquisição, fluxo e processamento.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Realizar análise de dados, navegar e revisar grandes conjuntos de dados, aprender e pesquisar funções de gerenciamento de dados de aplicativos e gerar relatórios.
  • Realizar investigações de monitoramento e alertas/escalonamento gerados pelo sistema relacionados a possíveis falhas no ambiente de serviço.
  • Interagir com engenheiros técnicos internos e fornecedores externos de terceiros para solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos.
  • Aplicar e desenvolver conhecimentos de tecnologia publicitária, especialmente operações de DSP, e processo de publicidade digital.
  • Ajudar a definir e testar automação de processos manuais.
  • Realizar acompanhamento diário, semanal e mensal de relatórios e fluxos de trabalho para garantir que as operações não sejam interrompidas.
  • Trabalhar entre equipes, como desenvolvimento, gerenciamento de produtos e grupos de finanças para pesquisar e resolver erros de cálculo de dados relatados pelo usuário.
  • Dar suporte às necessidades de faturamento financeiro, entendendo faturamento e relatórios em vários mercados/países, fornecendo suporte avançado a usuários internos e externos.
  • Criar, manter e documentar soluções de software/aplicativo e dados.

Esperamos Que Você Tenha

  • Licenciatura em Ciência da Computação ou Engenharia, Matemática ou Tecnologia.
  • 3+ anos de experiência de trabalho em uma função de gerenciamento de dados, suportando soluções de dados complexas.
  • Experiência de trabalho com análise de dados no setor de mídia de publicidade digital.
  • Experiência em liderar, orientar e auxiliar outros membros da equipe - a pessoa deve trabalhar extremamente bem em equipe e conseguir trabalhar em um ambiente multicultural e global com membros da equipe localizados remotamente.
  • Experiência de trabalho com SQL e habilidades avançadas de Microsoft Excel.
  • Capacidade de distinguir entre questões críticas e não críticas (forte capacidade de triagem e resolução de problemas).
  • Experiência de trabalho com as necessidades de Finanças e Faturamento.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Nível avançado de inglês.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil

  • Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.
  • Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.
  • Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.

Job description

Somos a 1° startup do Brasil a ter operações de Contact Center 100% no modelo home office.

Você é apaixonado por alcançar metas, está motivado a superar desafios e se colocar no lugar do outro enquanto faz parte de uma equipe dinâmica? Aqui é o seu lugar!!

Estamos à procura de profissionais dedicados, ambiciosos, apaixonados por alcançar metas e motivados a superar desafios para integrarem nossa equipe como Agentes de Atendimento, focados no SAC Multiskill para o e-commerce de uma marca de roupas e calçados.

Buscamos nos conectar com pessoas e aqui a gente preza pela igualdade de oportunidades e a inclusão da diversidade para todos os públicos. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades

  • Agente de solução em atendimento Multiskill via voz, ticket, e-mail e chat do e-commerce de uma rede de marcas de roupa de grife e calçados;
  • Você irá atender trocas e devoluções, estorno e reembolso;
  • Direcionar as reclamações e elogios recebidos aos setores/departamentos responsáveis;
  • Em todos os canais de comunicação é necessário ouvir atentamente o cliente buscando sempre o envolver, conduzir de forma prática o contato, possuir empatia, compreendendo a necessidade do cliente;
  • Nas mídias sociais será responsável por responder as reclamações e elogios dos clientes dos nossos anúncios.

Requisitos e habilidades

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência com atendimento em SAC de vestuário/e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento básico no ramo da moda;
  • Possuir agilidade, escrita e dicção boa;
  • Experiência com atendimento em multicanais – voz, chat e e-mail;
  • Possuir habilidades em atuar no modelo home office;
  • Ter um espaço adequado para atuar home office (Mesa, cadeira e ambiente sem ruído);
  • Residir em São Paulo/ Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencial em escritório no bairro Vila Olímpia sempre que requerido pela empresa/liderança;
  • Possuir internet cabeada com mais de 10 MB (Sem utilizar o Wifi);
  • Habilidade em manusear diversos plataformas de trabalho (Zendesk, WhatsApp, Telefone, chat e Pacote Office).

Escala de Trabalho: 6x1 – Horário a combinar de acordo com operação

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Auxilio Creche (Crianças de até 24 meses);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TotalPass;
  • Descontos em cursos, faculdade e parques de diversão.

Fornecemos Notebook, Mouse e Headset.

title: Principal Architect São Paulo, Brazil, Remote
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A \"Whatever it takes\" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description:
Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD

Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD role at Trilogy.

This range is provided by Trilogy. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$200.00/hr - $200.00/hr

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years in product leadership positions where you personally developed product vision and owned fundamental problem-solution hypotheses
  • Proven track record launching at least one successful product from conception to market—specifically a complete product (not just features) that reached external users and generated minimum $1M in revenue
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI tools into your professional workflow (analysis, research, strategy development, information synthesis)

About LearnWith.AI

LearnWith.AI is an edtech startup that leverages AI and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and AI-powered coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult for more details on this topic.

title: Software Engineering Manager (Vaga Afirmativa para Mulheres)
description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

  • Liderar e gerenciar equipes de tecnologia, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias tecnológicas alinhadas com os objetivos de negócio da empresa.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre equipes técnicas e não técnicas, garantindo que os projetos estejam alinhados com as expectativas dos stakeholders.
  • Promover a adoção de melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo metodologias ágeis e DevOps.
  • Garantir a qualidade e a segurança das soluções desenvolvidas pela equipe.
  • Possuir um perfil técnico, com a capacidade de desenhar soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que atendam às necessidades do negócio.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes de tecnologia, com um histórico de sucesso na entrega de projetos complexos e de alta escalabilidade.
  • Sólida compreensão técnica em engenharia backend.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e práticas de DevOps.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de desenhar soluções técnicas eficazes, alinhando tecnologia e estratégia do negócio

Para Realçar o Sabor:

  • Conhecimento em outras áreas de desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias emergentes.

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por inovação e tecnologia, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e que goste de desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você!

title: SUPERVISOR OPERAÇÕES LEVES ( AEROPORTO SALVADOR)
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the SUPERVISOR OPERAÇÕES LEVES ( AEROPORTO SALVADOR) role at Unidas .

A Unidas, integrante do grupo Brookfield, é uma das maiores empresas do setor de mobilidade no Brasil. Conta com cerca de 100 mil ativos entre veículos leves, caminhões, máquinas e equipamentos pesados, e oferece uma plataforma completa de soluções de gestão e locação de veículos, operações e manutenção. Conta também com mais de 200 lojas entre aluguel de carros e venda de seminovos, incluindo leves e pesados. A companhia, que tem mais de 4 mil colaboradores, é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil pelo ranking Great Place to Work. Possui diversas premiações e valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e o empoderamento do time.

Valorizamos que cada talento tenha o poder de transformar realidades e oferecemos as ferramentas, o ambiente e os desafios certos para isso acontecer. Somos um time que se movimenta em um único sentido: simplificar a vida dos nossos clientes com soluções completas, inovação em aluguel de ativos e serviços confiáveis.

Ao ingressar, você fará parte de uma organização com mais de 50 anos de história, presença em todo o Brasil e mais de 120 mil ativos em operação.

Responsibilities

  • Apoiar o time de analistas de operações garantindo a máxima disponibilidade dos carros para as lojas da Rede RAC obedecendo a um rigoroso padrão de qualidade (conservação, manutenção, limpeza e abastecimento) e de acordo com a demanda diária/futura.
  • Garantir engajamento da equipe para disponibilizar veículos com qualidade dentro do padrão Unidas.
  • Assegurar a escala e gestão da equipe para atendimento aos clientes, organização e funcionamento correto das lojas.
  • Garantir que as cobranças de reembolsáveis sejam realizadas dentro da meta pré-definida.

Qualifications

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Desejáveis conhecimentos de gestão em transportadoras, concessionárias, frotas e/ou locadoras.

Benefits & Information

  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Cartão Farmácia;
  • WellHub;
  • Clube de Vantagens;
  • Carro da empresa;
  • Cartão flex;
  • Programa de Lucros e Resultados.

Seja bem-vindo(a)! A Unidas acredita que carreira é jornada , não destino , com foco em pessoas, desenvolvimento contínuo e empoderamento individual. Somos uma das maiores empresas do Brasil no setor de mobilidade e terceirização de frotas, com soluções que vão de veículos leves a pesados e máquinas.

Conteúdos adicionais: Fortes oportunidades em diferentes regiões e atuação em diversas frentes, dentro de uma cultura que valoriza protagonismo, colaboração e diversidade.
